reviews.text: I took my 10-year-old husky for emergency pyometra surgery. After two weeks, she made a full recovery. He's one of the few vets left who enjoys treating animals without worrying about money. He's a good person and an excellent doctor. 🙏 Thank you. …

He's been my dogs' vet for over 30 years.
He's a wonderful person, highly professional. He always gives good advice. I wouldn't change him for anything in the world. Excellent.
I have known the doctor for 23 years, I have always trusted him and continue to do so. A heartfelt thank you for the love he puts into his work. Our furry friends are cared for very well with him.

I've been taking my dog ​​to Michele since she was two months old. He's an objective person who doesn't waste time. He always has an answer and is very sensitive to our furry friends. You can completely trust him with the care of our pets.
Dr. Perfetti, a truly exceptional man and professional.
Very good......I recommend it to everyone.
Very good and gentle with animals. Solved very complicated problems. Always gave appropriate advice. Thank you!
Excellent, to say the least! Always attentive and never miss a beat! They've always helped me with my dog, and if she's in good health, I always say thank you to them!
Very knowledgeable, helpful and friendly doctor
What can I say? He's a very conscientious vet, who knows how to make diagnoses without fooling people with unnecessary tests. He always tries to give good advice and is very honest with his prices!

Excellent veterinarian who loves animals
Helpful and friendly
The doctor is a very competent person, helpful, very attentive to the needs of the animal, honest and with great humanity.
Good vet one of the best
Dr. Perfetti is reassuring and serious. Very professional, kind, and thorough. He inspires trust and is always available.
